rules.summary: Do not infer material implementation or external-action authority.
Delegate only when the active task contract permits it.
Expose uncertainty and never suppress failures.
Review, monitor, and accept only the explicit full candidate head.
Preserve unrelated changes and avoid destructive Git operations.
Production installation and consumer adoption require separate authorization.
Change only the approved task scope and preserve unrelated work.
One task state authority and one active writer own each transition.
Honor the user's required response language.
Run only the verification contract approved for the repository and task.
After a healthy one-hour timeout, immediately re-wait without output or inspection.
